text:
Jules Huang: opened a short PR to clarify audit-export guidance around server-side redaction vs client-side pseudonymization and to add explicit CLI + SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024
Samir Patel: thanks. Two asks: (1) avoid provider-specific key paths in examples, use placeholders, (2) tone down prescriptive retention numbers.
Ravi Kapoor: noted. Also found customers copying the old JS snippet which uses different param names than the current JS SDK. I propose we label each snippet with the SDK name and version.
Jules Huang: good plan. I'll label Python v1.4.0, Go v1.0.0, JS v2.1.0 and include a CLI example.
Maria Gomes (Legal): legal request: first mention should be 'customer-managed key (CMK)'. Add short advisory: 'Customers must ensure CMK access follows least-privilege principles.' Also include: 'This page is informational and not legal advice.'
Jules Huang: added the CMK phrasing and the disclaimer. Also added a one-line section explaining when to prefer server-side redaction vs client-side pseudonymization.
Ravi Kapoor: can you paste the CLI + Python snippets here for quick sanity check?
Jules Huang: CLI: `redwood logs export --since 2024-01-01 --until 2024-01-31 --redact-sensitive --kms-key-id=KEY_ID`
Jules Huang: Python v1.4.0 snippet:
```python
import os
from redwood_audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
# server-side redaction request
client.export_logs(start_ts=1704067200, end_ts=1706745600, redact_sensitive=True, cmk_id='projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION/keyRings/NAME/cryptoKeys/KEY')
```
Samir Patel: replace the GCP-like path with the placeholder exactly like that. Also add a short example showing client-side pseudonymization for situations where customers process raw events before storing.
Jules Huang: added a small pseudonymization snippet and a clear line: 'Server-side redaction is recommended for PII-heavy exports; client-side pseudonymization is for customers who must retain specific fields but mask identifiers.'
Maria Gomes (Legal): approved the wording. Please add PR note: 'Legal review: 2026-03-22 by M. Gomes'.
docs-ci: build / docs:pr/1024: succeeded :white_check_mark: staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/security/audit-exports#redaction-handoff
Ravi Kapoor: LGTM, leaving one tiny formatting nit on the SDK version badges.
Samir Patel: merging in 5 unless objections. Jules please add redirects for any broken snippet links.
Jules Huang: merged. Changelog entry: 'Clarified server vs client redaction guidance; added SDK-versioned snippets; CMK phrasing; adjusted retention wording.'
